evals.prompt: Make this memo readable for executives
evals.expected_output: Applies an executive-readability pass — BLUF or Pyramid restructuring, tone transformation and formatting — and returns the polished document

evals.prompt: This brief is 1200 words and needs to be 600 without losing any of the numbers
evals.expected_output: Runs a compress-scope pass under the zero-precision-loss constraint, keeping every citation, figure and named entity

evals.prompt: Rewrite the opening so it leads with the recommendation instead of the background
evals.expected_output: Restructures the opening to BLUF, surfacing the recommendation first and demoting the background

evals.prompt: Before I send this to the board, how would the CFO read it?
evals.expected_output: Runs a review-scope pass with a finance/executive persona and returns that persona's pre-edit score and objections, not a generic copy edit

evals.prompt: Review this proposal from a legal and a technical perspective
evals.expected_output: Dispatches the legal and technical personas in parallel over the document and synthesises their feedback into prioritised findings under the review scope

evals.prompt: Does this landing page actually work for a non-technical buyer?
evals.expected_output: Selects an appropriate lay-audience persona under the review scope, scores the document against that persona's criteria and reports where it fails
